video_caption: The video opens with the name "Christina Hendricks" displayed in yellow text on a dark screen, indicating the guest's name. This transitions to a man in a black suit, white shirt, and green tie (Craig Ferguson), standing on a stage with red curtains, excitedly introducing his guest. Briefly, the screen shows a skeleton in a suit with glowing blue eyes behind a podium, accompanied by the text "JUNE 3RD 2013" (June 3rd, 2013), marking the episode's date. The host then points to the side of the stage, and a wooden door opens for the entrance of Christina Hendricks, a woman with red hair, elegantly dressed in a black lace dress. She walks onto the stage, smiling, where the host greets her with a handshake and a kiss on the cheek. They then walk hand-in-hand to the talk show set, which features a detailed wooden backdrop and large windows overlooking a city skyline at night. The woman in the black dress takes her seat in a beige armchair, and the man in the black suit settles behind his wooden desk, holding a blue card. They engage in conversation, smiling and laughing, with the host enthusiastically complimenting her dress and everything else, to which she responds with a laugh.

In a talk show setting, a woman with red, wavy hair, wearing a black lace dress, sits on a light-colored couch on the left. Opposite her, behind a dark wooden desk, a man in a black suit with a white shirt and dark tie, who has graying hair, is seated. A large window showing a city skyline at night is visible behind them. The man is actively gesturing with his hands while talking to the woman, at one point pointing to her hair. The woman responds by gesturing to her hair and then laughing heartily multiple times throughout the interaction. The man also smiles and laughs, making broad gestures as he speaks. On the man's desk, there is a distinct snake-shaped ceramic mug or sculpture. A white text overlay "THE JAYLENO FLY" appears briefly at the bottom left of the screen, while a CBS logo is visible at the bottom right.

In a talk show setting, a woman with red hair wearing a black lace dress is seated on a beige couch on the left, while a man in a black suit and tie sits at a wooden desk on the right. Both are actively conversing, using hand gestures and displaying a range of expressions from thoughtful engagement to laughter. A unique decorative mug and a small, shiny orb are placed on the desk between them. Behind the duo, large wooden-framed windows reveal a stunning nighttime cityscape, brightly lit with numerous buildings. The "CBS" logo is visible in the bottom right corner of the screen. The camera frequently cuts between a two-shot of both individuals and a close-up of the woman, highlighting her reactions and speech.

In a talk show setting, Christina Hendricks, a woman with red, wavy hair wearing a black lace dress, sits on a light brown armchair on the left, engaging in conversation with a man in a dark suit, presumably the host, Craig Ferguson, who is seated behind a dark wooden desk on the right. Behind them, a large window reveals a vibrant nighttime cityscape. As the man asks if she would eat guinea pig, he makes a dramatic, wide-eyed, open-mouthed expression with his hands miming something, to which the woman initially reacts with surprise, then considers it, making a small hand gesture and stating she would. The host listens intently, often with a slight smile and thoughtful expressions, while a decorative coiled snake with a patterned design sits on the desk between them, next to a small CBS logo.

In a television studio setting, a woman with auburn hair wearing a black lace dress sits on a light-colored armchair on the left, frequently gesturing with her hands as she speaks animatedly and smiles. She places her right hand on a dark wooden desk, at one point bringing her hands up to mimic an animal's teeth. Opposite her, a man in a black suit, white shirt, and dark tie is seated behind the desk, listening intently, smiling, and occasionally gesturing with his own hands, once resting his hand on his chin in a thoughtful pose. On the desk between them, there is a decorative, coiled snake-like object with a spotted pattern and a smaller, reflective disco-ball-like ornament, with a "CBS" logo visible on the desk. Large windows behind them reveal a vibrant city skyline at night, with numerous illuminated buildings.

In a TV talk show setting, a red-haired woman in a black lace dress sits in a beige armchair on the left, animatedly speaking and gesturing with her hands. She smiles, briefly covers her mouth with her hand, then clasps her hands together while continuing to smile at the man across from her. On the right, a man in a black suit reclines in his chair behind a wooden desk, initially listening intently with his chin resting on his hand. He then smiles, raises his hand in a "stop" or "wait" gesture, and laughs. Behind them, large windows overlook a sparkling night cityscape. On the desk, a unique serpent-designed mug is visible, along with a small white object and a "CBS" logo.

The video features a woman with prominent red hair wearing a black lace dress and a man in a black suit with a white shirt and dark tie, seated in a talk show setting. The man, on the right, is leaning casually on a brown desk, gesturing with his hands as he speaks to the woman. On the desk, there is a decorative, coiled object resembling a snake with an intricate pattern, and a "CBS" logo sticker. Behind them are large windows revealing a sprawling city skyline at night, with numerous illuminated buildings. The woman, seated on the left in a light-colored armchair, listens intently, occasionally nodding and making small gestures with her hands, such as bringing her fingertips together to indicate something small. Both individuals are engaged in a lively conversation, with the man looking at the woman and the woman reciprocating his gaze.

In a TV talk show setting, a woman with red, curly hair wearing a black lace dress sits on a light brown armchair to the left, while a man in a dark suit, white shirt, and dark tie sits behind a dark wooden desk to the right. The background features large windows showcasing a city skyline at night with numerous illuminated buildings. The woman is actively speaking, smiling, and gesturing with her hands, at one point laughing and briefly covering her face. The man responds, initially leaning back and gesturing, then at one point puts a hand to his chin in thought, and later smiles and gestures back towards the woman. On the desk, there's a decorative snake-shaped ceramic object and a small, round, possibly glass or crystal item. A white CBS logo in a blue circle is visible in the bottom right corner of the screen throughout the segment.

A woman with wavy red hair, wearing a black lace dress with a square neckline, is seated on a light brown sofa to the left. She is speaking, frequently gesturing with both hands, at times with palms open and then with fingers touching, her expression earnest and engaged. As the shot widens, a man with graying hair, dressed in a black suit, white shirt, and dark tie, is seen seated at a wooden desk to her right, facing her. He also speaks, gesturing with his right hand, and shares an engaged expression with the woman. On the desk, a distinctive, possibly snake-patterned mug is visible. Behind both individuals, a large window reveals a vibrant city skyline at night, filled with illuminated buildings. A white circular "CBS" logo in black text is displayed in the bottom right corner of the screen.

At the 00:06 mark, a woman with prominent red hair, styled in soft waves, is seated on the left in a light-colored armchair. She is wearing a fitted black dress with long lace sleeves and a scooped neckline, accessorized with a dark ring on her left hand. Her facial expression is animated as she speaks, using both hands to gesture, with her palms facing upward. To her right, a man with dark hair, dressed in a black suit, white shirt, and dark tie, sits behind a wooden desk. He is looking at the woman, leaning forward slightly, and gesturing with his hands clasped together on the desk. Behind them is a large window offering a nighttime view of a city skyline with numerous illuminated buildings. On the desk, near the man, there's a unique, brown and yellow patterned snake-shaped decorative item and a white CBS logo.

In a late-night talk show setting, a woman with red hair wearing a black lace dress sits on a beige armchair to the left, facing a man in a dark suit and green tie who is seated behind a wooden desk to the right. Behind them, a large window displays a city skyline at night. Initially, the woman smiles and laughs as the man gestures and speaks. The man then produces two harmonicas, handing one to the woman. She accepts it, and they both put the harmonicas to their mouths and begin to play, with the man leaning forward and the woman looking at him. As they play, yellow text appears on the screen: "Outro" is in the bottom right, and "The End" with "Outro Coming..." below it is in the bottom left. A CBS logo is also visible in the bottom right corner of the screen.

A woman in a blue short-sleeved dress and a man in a grey suit and striped tie are seated, facing each other, on a television set. The woman is on the left, sitting in a red armchair, while the man is behind a wooden desk on the right. They are engaged in conversation, both using animated hand gestures and facial expressions, often smiling and laughing. The background features a large window with a nighttime city skyline visible outside. On the desk, there is a unique coiled, decorative object. Throughout the clip, a yellow text box with an ornate border, reading "Outro," is displayed in the bottom right corner. At one point, the man leans back, covering his face with his hand, appearing amused, while the woman laughs and covers her mouth, then leans forward. Later, the text "Thanks For Watching!" appears in yellow on the screen. The video ends with both continuing to smile and gesture before fading to black.
